author: Janie Massey
title: Linda's Frozen Strawberry Cake
instructions_list: Tear angel food cake into small pieces and place them into a large mixing bowl. Stir angel food cake into softened vanilla ice cream.
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water, stirring until completely dissolved.
Add frozen strawberries and stir until cooled.
Mix the gelatin and strawberries with the cake and ice cream mixture.
Line a tube pan with plastic wrap.
Pour the mixture into the prepared pan.
Cover and freeze until solid; overnight if needed.
When ready to serve, turn it out onto a plate. Slice when ready to serve. Cover leftovers tightly with foil and store in the freezer.
description: This frozen strawberry cake is a nostalgic dessert that's a must during the summer. It turns store-bought ingredients into a fantastic dessert for summer parties. Strawberry gelatin mixed with softened vanilla ice cream gives this dessert a strawberries and cream vibe. Chunks of angel food cake are also folded in. Once frozen, the texture is similar to a mousse. If you add blueberries, you'll have an easy red, white, and blue patriotic-themed dessert.
